Hatchie National Wildlife Refuge, Haywood County, Tennessee
I am the originator of this photo. I hold the copyright. I release it to the public domain. This photo depicts flowers.
Flowerheads are compact clusters of blue-mauve to pink-mauve heads (6-8 mm wide), each with densely hairy bracts. Flowering is year-round.
